C-TABLE-FITTED-RESET.Name: Keep fitted tables inside their frame after partial column reset
C-TABLE-FITTED-RESET.ApprovalBasis: Owner regression report on 2026-11-10 after accepting sequential resizing: in Fit, double-clicking the second internal border after resizing exposes horizontal scrolling, and resetting the first normalizes it. Standing delegation covers the bounded repair of this existing no-scroll contract.
C-TABLE-FITTED-RESET.Summary: Route partial column resets through the selected mode layout before persistence, retaining the column-reset meaning and manual choices that remain.

Goals.Goal: Fit/Full stay in the same mode and frame immediately after either internal border is double-clicked following sequential drags. Persisted geometry is the fitted result. Repeated resets, tab adoption and reconciliation do not restore overflow.

Constraints.Item: Retain adjacent resizing, the measured per-column reset semantics, automatic whole-table reset when no manual columns remain, Auto behavior, wrapping and narrow-frame fitting. Keep Markdown/history/saved state, thresholds, retries, timeouts, schema and application version unchanged.

NonGoals.Item: No redesign of reset semantics, new scrolling mode, profile migration, release or mutation of an open user document.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A real-pointer red/green reproduction covers the second-border-then-first-border reset after resizing, with frame, no-scroll, mode and exact Markdown/saved oracles. Unit evidence pins immediate fitted store and persisted geometry.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Focused reproduction, existing sizing units, full affected table/viewer browser gate in Chromium/WebKit, renderer build and a fresh uniquely identified QA artifact.
